title: Broker-Shipper Transportation Agreement
intro: This Broker-Shipper Transportation Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Y7 Consulting Inc., a Massachusetts corporation ("Y7 Logistics", "we", "us", or "our"), and the Customer identified in the quote request ("Customer", "you", or "your"). Y7 Consulting Inc. is a licensed property broker authorized by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (USDOT Number 4427359, Motor Carrier Number 1741537).

section1.title: 1. Service Description — Y7 is a Broker, Not a Carrier
section1.body: Y7 Consulting Inc. operates as a licensed property broker under 49 CFR Part 371. Y7 arranges transportation of motor vehicles by contracting with duly authorized motor carriers. Y7 does NOT operate motor vehicles, does NOT transport vehicles, and does NOT employ drivers. All actual transportation services are performed by independent motor carriers selected by Y7 from its network of vetted carriers. Customer acknowledges and agrees that Y7 is acting solely as an intermediary and is not responsible for the acts, omissions, or performance of any carrier.

section2.title: 2. Service Fee Schedule
section2.body: Y7 charges a non-refundable dispatch fee for brokerage services. Customer selects one of two service tiers at the time of order confirmation:
tiers: Standard (Cash-on-Delivery or "COD"): $50.00 USD. Y7 arranges carrier transport. Customer pays the assigned carrier directly upon successful delivery after vehicle inspection. Payment methods accepted by carriers typically include cash, cashier's check, or money order.

Full Service: $65.00 USD plus the carrier transport cost. Y7 arranges carrier transport AND disburses payment to the carrier on Customer's behalf following successful delivery confirmation. Customer pays the total amount (carrier cost plus $65.00 dispatch fee) via credit or debit card at order confirmation.
section2.feeIncludes: The dispatch fee covers: carrier sourcing, quote negotiation, dispatch coordination, shipment monitoring, and customer support throughout the transportation process. The fee does NOT include the underlying carrier transportation cost, fuel surcharges, toll fees, storage fees, or any ancillary charges imposed by the carrier.

section2_ind2026.title: 2. Service Fee Schedule
section2_ind2026.body: Y7 charges a non-refundable broker service fee for brokerage services, calculated as follows:
tiers: Broker Service Fee: the GREATER of $75.00 USD or 10% (ten percent) of the carrier transport price. At the time of quoting, Y7 discloses the fee as a range computed from the quoted carrier price range; the final fee amount is fixed when a carrier is assigned, based on the actual carrier transport price.

Carrier Payment (COD): the carrier transport price is paid by Customer (or Customer's designated recipient) DIRECTLY to the assigned motor carrier — in cash or certified funds — at pickup or at delivery, as agreed with the carrier. Y7 does not collect the carrier transport price. The broker service fee is paid to Y7 separately.
section2_ind2026.feeIncludes: The broker service fee covers: carrier sourcing, quote negotiation, dispatch coordination, shipment monitoring, and customer support throughout the transportation process. The fee does NOT include the underlying carrier transportation cost, fuel surcharges, toll fees, storage fees, or any ancillary charges imposed by the carrier.

checkboxes_ind2026.payment: I understand the broker service fee (the greater of $75.00 USD or 10% of the carrier transport price, disclosed as a range on my quote and fixed when my carrier is assigned), the payment terms, and my obligation to pay the carrier directly (COD) at pickup or at delivery.

section3.title: 3. Cancellation and Refund Policy
section3.body: Customer may cancel a confirmed order subject to the following terms:
bullets: Cancellation within 24 hours of payment AND before a carrier has been assigned to the order: Full refund of all amounts paid to Y7.
Cancellation after 24 hours from payment OR after a carrier has been assigned to the order: Refund minus a $10.00 administrative fee, which covers dispatch coordination work already performed.

Full Service orders: payment processing fees charged by Stripe (currently approximately 2.9% plus $0.30 per transaction) are non-refundable and will be deducted from any refund amount, as these fees are not returned to Y7 by Stripe.
Standard (COD) orders: Y7 absorbs Stripe processing fees. Customer receives the full refund amount as stated above.
Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 business days and credited to the original payment method.

No-show at pickup: if the vehicle is not available for pickup at the scheduled time and location, and no prior rescheduling was arranged, the dispatch fee is non-refundable and additional carrier charges may apply.
Y7 reserves the right to issue a full refund at its sole discretion for customer service purposes, waiving the administrative fee.

section4.title: 4. Customer Obligations and Representations
section4.body: Customer represents, warrants, and agrees that:
bullets: All information provided (including but not limited to name, contact information, vehicle identification, pickup and delivery locations, and payment method) is true, accurate, current, and complete.
Customer is the lawful owner of the vehicle(s) to be transported or has obtained express authorization from the lawful owner to arrange transportation.
Customer has disclosed all material facts about the vehicle, including operability status, presence of modifications, and any existing damage, on the quote request.
Customer will not tender for transport any vehicle containing stolen goods, contraband, controlled substances, hazardous materials, or any items prohibited by federal, state, or local law.
Customer acknowledges that personal items left inside the vehicle are transported at Customer's sole risk and are not covered by carrier insurance or Y7's liability provisions.

Customer will inspect the vehicle at pickup and delivery, sign the Bill of Lading (BOL) issued by the carrier, and note any damage on the BOL before signing. Failure to note damage on the BOL waives Customer's right to claim for such damage.
Customer authorizes Y7 to share Customer's contact information with the assigned carrier solely for the purpose of coordinating pickup and delivery.
Inoperable vehicles (non-running, non-steering, non-braking) require special equipment and may incur additional fees of $100 to $300. Customer must accurately disclose operability status.

section5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
section5.body: THIS SECTION LIMITS Y7's LIABILITY. READ CAREFULLY.
bullets: Y7's total liability to Customer for any and all claims arising out of or related to this Agreement or the brokerage services provided shall not exceed the dispatch fee paid by Customer for the specific shipment at issue.

Y7 is NOT liable for: (a) vehicle damage occurring during transport (carrier's cargo insurance applies, subject to the carrier's policy terms); (b) carrier delays or failure to meet pickup or delivery windows; (c) acts of God, weather events, road conditions, traffic, or civil unrest; (d) mechanical failure of the vehicle during transport; (e) loss of or damage to personal items left in the vehicle; (f) consequential, incidental, special, punitive, or indirect damages of any kind, including lost profits, lost use, or rental car expenses; (g) damage that existed prior to pickup and was not documented on the Bill of Lading; (h) any act or omission of the carrier, including but not limited to negligence, misconduct, or breach of the carrier's obligations.

Carrier liability is governed by the carrier's own insurance policy and the Bill of Lading executed between Customer and the carrier at pickup. Customer's primary recourse for transportation-related damage is against the carrier and the carrier's insurer. All carriers in Y7's network maintain minimum $100,000 cargo insurance as a Y7 network verification requirement, with most carrying $250,000 or more. Y7 verifies active coverage through Central Dispatch before dispatching any load.

In the event of vehicle theft, fire, or total loss during transport, the carrier's cargo insurance applies up to the policy limit. Customer should immediately file a police report (in case of theft) and contact Y7. Y7 will provide the carrier's insurance information and assist in filing the claim. Vehicle valuation for total loss is determined by the carrier's insurance provider based on actual cash value at the time of loss.

The limitations and exclusions in this Section 5 apply whether the claim is based in contract, tort (including negligence), statute, or any other legal theory, and apply even if Y7 has been advised of the possibility of such damages.

section6.title: 6. Consent to Electronic Communications
section6.body: By accepting this Agreement, Customer acknowledges and agrees that:
bullets: Customer has consented separately to receive SMS messages from Y7 via an opt-in checkbox on the quote form. SMS consent is revocable at any time by replying STOP to any message. Message and data rates may apply.

Customer has consented separately to Y7's Terms of Service (version 2.0 or later) and Privacy Policy (version 2.0 or later). These consents are recorded in Y7's consent audit trail with timestamp, IP address, and consent-text hash.

Customer authorizes Y7 to send transactional email notifications (order confirmations, payment receipts, carrier assignments, and delivery notifications) to the email address provided. Transactional email is not marketing communication and cannot be opted out of while an active order exists.
Customer may opt out of marketing email at any time via the unsubscribe link included in all marketing communications.

section7.title: 7. Data Protection and Privacy
section7.body: Y7 processes Customer personal data in accordance with Y7's Privacy Policy (version 2.0 or later), available at https://www.y7agency.com/privacy. Key data-protection provisions include:
bullets: Y7 complies with Massachusetts 201 CMR 17.00 (Standards for the Protection of Personal Information of Residents of the Commonwealth) and maintains a Written Information Security Program (WISP).

For Customers located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, Y7 complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and has implemented Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers.

Customer personal data is retained for a minimum of 7 years following order completion, consistent with FMCSA record-retention requirements under 49 CFR 379. Customer's right to erasure (where applicable under GDPR Article 17) is limited to data not required to be retained by law.
Data subject access requests, erasure requests, or other privacy inquiries should be directed to info@y7agency.com.

section8.title: 8. Dispute Resolution
section8.body: Customer and Y7 agree as follows:
bullets: Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the brokerage services, or the Customer relationship shall first be attempted to be resolved through good-faith negotiation for a period of thirty (30) days.

If negotiation does not resolve the dispute, the parties agree to submit the dispute to binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Consumer Arbitration Rules, with the arbitration taking place in Middlesex County, Massachusetts, unless the parties mutually agree to another location.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may pursue any claim arising under Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 93A (Consumer Protection Act) in the appropriate Massachusetts court, provided that Customer has first sent a Chapter 93A demand letter as required by M.G.L. c. 93A § 9(3).
Customer and Y7 each waive the right to a jury trial for any claim subject to arbitration under this section.
Customer may opt out of the arbitration provision (but not the jury waiver or choice of law) by sending written notice to Y7 at info@y7agency.com within 30 days of first accepting this Agreement.

section9.title: 9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
section9.body: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles. For any disputes not subject to arbitration under Section 8, the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Middlesex County, Massachusetts.

section10.title: 10. Modifications
section10.body: Y7 may modify this Agreement from time to time. Y7 will provide Customer with at least 30 days' advance notice of material changes via email to the address on file. Continued use of Y7's services after the effective date of the modified Agreement constitutes acceptance of the modifications. Historical versions of this Agreement are preserved in Y7's consent audit trail and remain effective for transactions completed under them.

section11.title: 11. Severability and Entire Agreement
section11.body: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect. This Agreement, together with the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and the SMS consent granted at quote submission, constitutes the entire agreement between Customer and Y7 regarding the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, and communications, whether oral or written.

acceptance.body: By clicking "I Agree" or by continuing to use Y7's services after being presented with this Agreement, Customer acknowledges that Customer has read, understood, and agreed to be bound by all terms of this Agreement.
